description: Atlyn Word Cloud turns a free-text column into a densely packed, weighted word cloud so Power BI authors can see what people actually talk about. Words are sized by raw frequency, by any measure you supply, or by TF-IDF when you want distinctive terms rather than merely common ones. A configurable stop-word list removes filler, and an optional offline English sentiment lexicon colours words positive, negative, or neutral without a single network call. The visual supports click and multi-select cross-filtering, highlighting, bookmarks, tooltips carrying word weight and occurrence counts, a maximum word count with an overflow footnote, Power BI report themes, high contrast, and keyboard focus. Typical uses include survey verbatims, support tickets, product reviews, and social or employee feedback. The included sample report demonstrates all four weighting and colouring modes offline. The visual is free for personal and commercial use under the MIT License; no purchase, subscription, account, or license key is required.
